pages.title: Submarines
pages.text: **Create Deep Seas** adds submarines. A sub is a Create-style contraption that moves as one solid, physical vessel, built on the same Sable and Aeronautics tech as [#](2E5AAC)[airships](entry://flight/airships)[#](). It dives by changing its own weight.

A submarine floats until its **Ballast Tanks** are filled with sea water. A **Ballast Vent** is the sea valve and must touch the water. Pipe vent, pump and tanks together: pumping in makes the ship heavier and it sinks, pumping out lets it rise.

Each tank lifts roughly one block of ship mass, so heavy hulls need more tanks.

pages.title: Ballast Tank
pages.text: Holds the water that weighs the ship down. Read its capacity with Engineer's Goggles.

pages.title: Ballast Vent
pages.text: The sea valve. At least one face must touch the sea. Every face takes a pipe.

The **Onboard Computer** can dive for you. Click its screen to set a target depth and speed, and it drives the pumps to hold that depth. **Pump Controllers** on the same ship are found automatically; pipe one between vent and tanks. More controllers or faster rotation mean quicker dives.

pages.title: Onboard Computer
pages.text: Autopilot for depth. With a Sonar on board it can also follow the sea floor and keep the keel clear.

pages.title: Sonar
pages.text: Maps the floor, rocks, ships and mines around you on the Computer's screen.

Pumps and thrusters run on Create [#](2E5AAC)[rotation](entry://create_basics/rotation)[#]() and [#](2E5AAC)[fluids](entry://create_basics/fluids)[#](), so a sub is a Create machine through and through. Press **W** over any Deep Seas block for its Ponder.

pages.title: Submarine Propeller
pages.text: Strong in water, useless in air. Four in a 2x2 square facing one way merge into one big propeller.

pages.title: Water Thruster
pages.text: Uses water and rotation for thrust. More pressure and speed push you faster.

Hull strength, oxygen and airlocks are covered in [#](2E5AAC)[Hulls and Pressure](entry://ocean/hulls_and_pressure)[#](). Surface ships and sails are in [#](2E5AAC)[Sailing](entry://ocean/sailing)[#](). Where to dive: [#](2E5AAC)[Underwater Places](entry://ocean/underwater_places)[#](). Deep Seas also holds an unfinished Create Abyss dimension, but it only switches on in development builds, so it is not in this pack.
